scope: Manual record of the first cache full-run failure observed in the tool session. The old runner buffered stdout and lost the partial transcript on TimeoutExpired; no passed-suite claim is made.
observations: Payment HTTP test child remained live for over five minutes with one isolated schema remaining.
Only that identity-checked child was stopped; its exact isolated schema was removed.
The full runner later timed out; a subsequent process inventory found no remaining Node test processes.
cause: The original service rejection and stalled barrier were not captured. An early failure before an awaited RPC barrier is a supported harness failure mode; the past trigger remains unresolved.
followup: HTTP barriers now surface bounded early status/body errors and have a fixed timeout.
Service barriers race the expected callback against the already-bounded service completion.
The runner streams transcripts and records timeout/owned-tree cleanup; its two tests pass.
